doc: The Application — machine-readable mirror of world/applications.md (v45). Actor-facing layer: how a character asks for work or a room, who screens, what the trial tests, how a no sounds. jobs-housing.md + market.json remain canonical for numbers/channels; the audit gate asserts agreement. Game dollars only — zero credit figures in this layer. Conditions, never scripts; declines never hit the feed.
decline_rule: voiced in-world per channel; spectator surface sees at most the card coming down or the listing delisted — never the applicant, never the reason

job_apps.apply: Reply card pinned under the listing, or ask for Marisol at the counter before 9:00

screen.watches: reads the card replies herself, then watches how you wait for her
asks: what shift did you last close

trial.passes_on: unhurried competence under the line; a clean till count; tables bussed unasked

never: no application fee above real screening cost, disclosed on the form
no rent bidding, no pay-to-interview, no pay-to-see-a-listing
no feed event names an applicant or a decline — hires surface only as a new face
trial shifts are paid unless the entry says otherwise in plain words
an application never leaks a secret — screening texture is surface knowledge
